code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, and mild hypoglycemia. There is also mild renal impairment (elevated urea and creatinine). Elevated monocytes and basophils are noted. These findings may indicate bone marrow suppression or infiltration, possible chronic disease, and impaired oxygenation. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
